description: Corrects one customer's or vendor's (supplier's) name, e-mail and postal address in a set of books. It replaces all three: pass the current values (from find_contacts) for what should stay, and an empty e-mail or address to remove it. The address is free text, one line per address line (at most 500 characters). Owners and employees are not changed here. Confirm the change with the user first. Nothing is posted or sent.

address.description: The postal address, lines separated by line breaks; empty removes it.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

email.description: The e-mail address; empty removes it.

name: update_contact
title: Correct a customer or vendor
